description: This is a Java test class named ImmutableEnforcementFilterTest that contains unit tests for the ImmutableEnforcementFilter class. The tests verify immutability, equality/hashCode, placeholder parsing, enforcement logic, and enforcement filtering mechanisms related to connectivity enforcement features in the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: ImmutableEnforcementFilterTest
classes.description: JUnit test class that verifies the immutability, equality, and enforcement logic of ImmutableEnforcementFilter class.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that instances of ImmutableEnforcementFilter are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that equals and hashCode methods of ImmutableEnforcementFilter are properly implemented.

methods.name: testSimplePlaceholderPrefixed
methods.description: Tests placeholder substitution when the placeholder is prefixed in the string.

methods.name: testSimplePlaceholderPostfixed
methods.description: Tests placeholder substitution when the placeholder is postfixed in the string.

methods.name: testSimpleThingIdPlaceholderAndEntityIdFilter
methods.description: Tests placeholder handling with ThingId and Enforcement filtering.

methods.name: testSimplePolicyIdPlaceholderAndEntityIdFilter
methods.description: Tests placeholder handling with PolicyId and Enforcement filtering.

methods.name: testSimpleEntityIdPlaceholderAndEntityIdFilter
methods.description: Tests placeholder handling with DefaultNamespacedEntityId and Enforcement filtering.

methods.name: testSimplePlaceholderPreAndPostfix
methods.description: Tests placeholder substitution with both prefix and postfix in the string.

methods.name: testSimplePlaceholderPreAndPostfixFails
methods.description: Expects failure when placeholder substitution logic is invalid.

methods.name: testSimplePlaceholderWithUnresolvableInputPlaceholder

methods.name: testSimplePlaceholderWithUnresolvableMatcherPlaceholder
methods.description: Ensures UnresolvedPlaceholderException is thrown when matcher placeholder cannot be resolved.
